name: Annotate
description: Span and document-level annotation. Works with or without storage: with it, annotators work through durable assigned queues; without it, one pass over whatever the previous step produced, kept in the browser.

config.label: Task name
config.help: Describes one task. Belongs to the composer only until there is a runtime screen for creating tasks; then it becomes a session-only setting.

config.label: Labels
config.help: Comma-separated. Colours are assigned automatically. Belongs to the composer only until there is a runtime screen for creating labelsets.

config.label: Annotation level
config.help: Span granularity. 'document' tags whole documents instead of spans.

config.label: Number of annotators
config.help: Every annotator is assigned every document. Agreement metrics need at least two.
